honesty_rules: Firing rules are extracted from .github/workflows/quota-dispatch-tree.yml at collection time, never transcribed from prose.
Run ages and busy counts are the observation snapshot's stamped read (read_at), not live claims at page-view time.
The admission sample series starts at the first collection; earlier busy history does not exist and is never backfilled.
A lane is 'due' only against a staleness threshold the workflow itself defines; phase-only lanes carry due=null.
Verdicts are read from dispatch jobs' 'Wake lane' step conclusions (success = woken, skipped = not woken); the decide step's summary table is not exposed by the API and is not reconstructed.

Supabase verdict persistence is reported as observed (repo variables present, persistence step conclusion); anon SELECT on dispatch_verdicts returns no rows under its insert-only RLS, so the table is not a read source for this feed.

admission.comment_says: when too many lane runs are already live
admission.code_counts: ALL repo workflow runs with status queued or in_progress (listWorkflowRunsForRepo, no workflow filter) — dominated in practice by PR check fan-outs, not tree lanes
admission.samples_note: Series begins at first collection (see samples[0].read_at). No earlier busy history exists in any record this collector can read; none is backfilled.

supabase_verdicts.note: Checked firsthand at first collection: the REST endpoint answers and anon SELECT returns [] — consistent with the workflow's own comment (anon INSERT only, RLS-gated). The step's per-run conclusion is carried on each tree run above; row contents are not readable with the anon key and are not used as a feed source.

gaps.detail: No record holds repo-wide busy counts before the first observation snapshot; the sample series is append-only from that point.
The decide step's 'Decision tree verdicts' summary table is not exposed by the Actions API; this feed carries the equivalent evidence from dispatch jobs' Wake lane step conclusions.
dispatch_verdicts rows cannot be read back with the anon key (insert-only RLS); persistence is evidenced by the step conclusion, not row contents.
